searchText: Thanks! I think the key thing to figure out is, for those contracts that have `SELFDESTRUCT`, what do they use it for? So here's one quick-pass thing that you can do: identify how many contracts that are destructible, that were created with `CREATE2` (and so can conceivably be recreated at the same address) Thanks for the feedback! Checking for redeployable contracts are already on my TODO list, and is definitely one potential use case that will no longer work after neutering selfdestruct. I will search for such contracts once I have extracted data about how the contracts were deployed.
